title: Management Consultant
description:
Join our firm as a Management Consultant. Key Responsibilities:
- Analyze client business operations to identify areas for improvement.
- Develop and present strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
- Facilitate organizational change and process optimization initiatives.
- Lead cross-functional project teams to implement solutions.
Requirements:
- MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration or related field.
- Proven experience in management consulting or strategic planning.
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong executive presence and communication abilities.
